p: that You renew for us a good and sweet year."
"A good year" means in words of Torah,
for "good" without qualification refers to words of Torah,
And it is written (Mishlei 6:23): "And Torah is light."
And the first time "good" is mentioned in the Torah
וַיַּרְא אֱלֹהִים אֶת הָאוֹר כִּי טוֹב
"And Elokim saw the light, that it was good";
corresponding to the five Chumashim of the Torah."
עַל הַפָּסוּק (בְּרֵאשִׁית א, ג) יְהִי אוֹר וַיְהִי אוֹר
on the pasuk (Bereishis 1:3) "Let there be light, and there was light":
"'Let there be light' — this is Pesach,
'and there was light' — this is Rosh Hashanah."
That is, on Pesach there was
the beginning of the revelation of the light that is good,
but afterwards it was hidden from them,
"They went three days in the wilderness
and water means words of Torah,
וּבַזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב ס, א)
And in the holy Zohar (Zohar II 60a):
וְכִי מַאן יָהִיב לְהוּ אוֹרַיְיתָא הָכָא
דְּקוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא תּוֹרָה אִיקְרֵי וְכוּלֵּי
that the Holy One, blessed be He, is called Torah ...."
Meaning: the essence of the light
is that it shine into the heart
that there is One Who created the world;
this is the aim of the entire Torah,
and this is "And Torah is light."
וְעַל רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה נֶאֱמַר וַיְהִי אוֹר
And of Rosh Hashanah it is said "and there was light,"
for the light already has existence:
the words of Torah are renewed with new faces
שֶׁבְּכָל שַׁבָּת וְשַׁבָּת יֵשׁ קְדוּשָּׁה מְיוּחֶדֶת
for every Shabbos has a holiness of its own
from the words of Torah of the parashah
וּבְכָל שָׁנָה מִתְחַדֵּשׁ כָּל הַדִּבְרֵי תוֹרָה
and every year all the words of Torah are renewed
For in the month of Nissan it is the renewal of the moon,
which receives from the light of the sun,
while Tishrei is the light of the sun itself,
which is the aspect of the Written Torah;
and every year it is studied anew
over the cycle of the year.
corresponding to the years of his reign."
That is, according to his error
his intent in the service was for the sake of Heaven,
הָיָה מְחַדֵּשׁ בְּכָל שָׁנָה פָּנִים אֲחֵרִים
he would innovate each year new facets
which is the book of the service of the korbanos,
and he thought he was intending it for Heaven.
And this is what we ask:
"that You renew for us a good year" —
that the renewal of the year be in words of Torah,
which is the light that is good.
"And sweeter than honey and the drippings of the honeycomb";
that is, that they feel taste in words of Torah,
"This is one who reveals the things
that the Ancient of Days concealed;
and what are they? The reasons of the Torah" —
that they feel taste in words of Torah,
that the words of Torah enter
into the depths of the heart.
And it is written (Koheles 11:7): "And the light is sweet";
that is, when one feels the taste in words of Torah
with the understanding of the heart,
that is the seeing of the light,
in line with what is said (Koheles 1:16):
"And my heart has seen much wisdom."
"Honey and milk are under your tongue,"
And this is the custom of eating an apple in honey,
"Like an apple tree among the trees of the forest":
"Why are Yisrael likened to an apple? ...
so too Yisrael put 'we will do' before 'we will hear'";
for at the time of Mattan Torah
Yisrael were likened to an apple.
And although the pasuk "Like an apple tree ..."
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁהִקְשׁוּ בַּתּוֹסָפוֹת (שָׁם, דִּבּוּר הַמַּתְחִיל פִּרְיוֹ)
רַק כֵּיוָן שֶׁנִּמְשַׁל הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ לְתַפּוּחַ
yet since Hashem Yisbarach is likened to an apple,
Yisrael are likened to an apple as well,
in line with what they said (Tanchuma Kedoshim 2):
"Since you have been sanctified to My Name ...,
הֱיוּ קְדוֹשִׁים כְּשֵׁם שֶׁאֲנִי קָדוֹשׁ וְכוּלֵּי
be holy just as I am holy ....
A parable: to what may this be compared?
To a king who betrothed a woman.
He said to her, 'Since you have been betrothed to my name,
I am king and you are queen;
כְּשֵׁם שֶׁהוּא כְּבוֹדִי כָּךְ הוּא כְּבוֹדֵךְ
just as it is my honor, so it is your honor.'"
So once Hashem Yisbarach is likened to an apple,
Yisrael too are likened to an apple.
And it is written (ibid.): "In His shade I delighted and sat,
and His fruit is sweet to my palate";
וְהוּא עַל דֶּרֶךְ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר וּמָתוֹק הָאוֹר
this is in line with "And the light is sweet."
And this is what we ask:
"that You renew for us a good year" —
with the light of Torah, which is called good;
that there be "and the light is sweet" in words of Torah;
וּמִמֵּילָא נִכְלָל בָּזֶה גַּם כָּל הַטּוֹבוֹת
and with this, all good things are included as well.
